rachel_csm: Quick weekly check-in for AcmeCorp — sending p95/p99 breakdown by route/model and streaming vs non-streaming. Main things to flag: streaming p99 spikes on primary chat model and a small bump in streaming error rate. @tom_eng can you triage?

opsbot: Automated report for AcmeCorp (week ending 2026-02-28):
```
route                  model        streaming  p95(ms)  p99(ms)  error_rate
chat.completions       gptj-3b      no         210      430      0.12%
chat.stream            gptj-3b      yes        340      790      0.95%
chat.completions       gemini-xl    no         170      390      0.08%
chat.stream            gemini-xl    yes        255      620      0.67%
embeddings.text        emb-small    no         48       115      0.02%
rerank                 rerank-v1    no         95       180      0.10%
```

rachel_csm: TL;DR: streaming p99 for gptj-3b is ~790ms (up ~200ms WoW). Spend for AcmeCorp is up 12% this week, mostly driven by longer streaming sessions (avg tokens/session +18%). Renewal touchpoint in 3 weeks — want to address before the exec call.

tom_eng: Looking. Initial hypothesis: KV-cache misses + smaller batch sizes for streaming are causing higher tail. I can run a quick profiling job against their traffic slice. @sam_runtime can you check batching config and current cache hit metrics?

sam_runtime: On it. I see their streaming path uses immediate-flush policy (max latency target 50ms) which reduces batching. Cache hit ratio for gptj-3b streaming: 72% (non-streaming 88%). Will try bumping inter-chunk aggregation to 80ms in staging.

neha_support: FYI customer noted intermittent 502s on stream sessions in last 48h (support ticket #AC-4721). Error rate in report is ~0.95% for streaming gptj-3b. I filed a retry-policy change request earlier today — might reduce observed errors but could increase cost.
tom_eng: OK. Plan: 1) run profiler to confirm KV misses + kernel hotpath, 2) test relaxed immediate-flush (80ms) in staging, 3) validate error-source (gateway vs model runtime). I'll target results by EOD tomorrow.

rachel_csm: Good. Can we also prepare a one-pager for the renewal call summarizing: current p95/p99, root-cause hypothesis, impact on UX, recommended mitigations and expected delta on spend? I want something concise for the CSM deck.

sam_runtime: I can draft the mitigation outcomes with numbers from staging run. Expected: increase p95 slightly (~+10-20ms) but drop p99 by ~200-300ms for streaming and reduce token spend by ~5-8% from fewer retries.

neha_support: I'll loop in the customer success manager and set up a short enablement session with AcmeCorp's infra contact — go over best-practices for streaming (prefix caching, session chunking). Scheduled provisional slot Wed 10am PT.
opsbot: Link to dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/acmecorp/latency-weekly (view=streaming-vs-nonstream)

rachel_csm: Action items: @tom_eng run profiler (due +1d), @sam_runtime run staging config change & report metrics (due +1d), @neha_support schedule enablement and send pre-read (due +2d). I'll draft the renewal one-pager after we get staging numbers.

tom_eng: Noted. If profiler shows model-kernel regressions I'll spin a hotfix branch; otherwise we proceed with batching tweak.

sam_runtime: Starting staging test now. Will post results (p95/p99, cache-hit, avg tokens/session) in this thread when done.

neha_support: Also flagged renewal risk as "monitoring" in CRM — will escalate to "at-risk" only if we don't see improvement in 48h after mitigation.

rachel_csm: Thanks team. Small ask: keep messages short in this thread so I can paste into the deck. :thumbsup:

opsbot: Update: staging run snapshot posted (1769123600) — see dashboard above.

sam_runtime: Staging results: streaming gptj-3b with 80ms aggregation -> p95 300ms, p99 510ms, cache-hit 85%. Errors down to 0.35%. I'll open a rollout PR for canary duration 2h.
tom_eng: Looks promising. Approving canary rollout.

rachel_csm: Perfect. I'll update the one-pager with before/after numbers and a note on expected spend delta. Will share draft in next 12h.

neha_support: Confirmed enablement session invited — will attach the one-pager as pre-read.
achel_csm: Closing loop — thanks everyone. Will follow up after canary metrics stabilize. :white_check_mark:
